reuse.why: Uses the shared isWeekendSkippedDaily and getDateWithSkippedWeekend plus recurConfigToRSchedule, but recomposes them by hand rather than through a shared 'occurrence -> final date or skipped' function.

duplication.why: The filter-weekend-if-daily then shift-if-skipWeekend pipeline and RSchedule/try/captureBreadcrumb scaffolding are copied from getUpcomingDates, so the composition of the weekend rule now exists at one more site.

placement.why: The handler sits next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered identically.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and its tests.

maintainability.why: Short and readable with a named window constant, but a future change to how the weekend rule composes must be made in getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, getNextDate and the template code separately.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied pipeline is near-verbatim (only the shift condition hoisted into movesWeekend), not disguised.
